description: Your hands may carry cards that are not part of them. Those cards still score their own pips instead of being billed as penalties.

name: Shady Stimulants
description: Every negative reward tile you swallow sharpens you - permanently +1 maximum Focus per tile taken.

name: Greedy Boi
description: +2 selection size in the reward grid - grab more tiles at once.

name: Scavenger
description: Whenever a curse lifts, gain +10 coins and +1 discard next round.

name: Coin Toss
description: At the start of each round, every Sleight has a 50% chance to restore 1 charge.

name: Martyr
description: Discarding a non-discard Sleight restores 1 charge to all Sleights on the grid.

name: Surveyor
description: When you gain a position Trick, you choose which column it marks.

name: Leveler
description: When you gain a position Trick, you choose which row it marks.

name: Alignment
description: Position Tricks automatically mark the column matching their tray slot (slot 3 → column 3).

name: District
description: Position Tricks may share a row or column instead of spreading onto separate lines.

name: Tempo
description: When acquired, sets your swap and discard limits to 2. Every 15 seconds, gain 1 back - alternating swap, then discard.

name: Jury-Rig
description: Swapping or discarding a card adjacent to a Sleight has a 50% chance to restore 1 charge to it. Rolls separately for each adjacent Sleight.

name: Dividend
description: Each time you reach max Focus, gain 8 credits, then Focus resets to a third of max.

name: Trade Winds
description: Your max Focus is 10 lower. At the end of each round, gain credits equal to half your current Focus.

name: Growth Spurt
description: Each time you reach max Focus, your max Focus drops by 5. If you reached max Focus during a round, a random limit rises by 1 at the end of that round.

name: Stimulants
description: +10 maximum Focus while owned.

name: Long Fuse
description: You have 2× as long to earn the same Focus speed bonus.

name: Shorthand
description: Hands generate 1.5× their listed Focus.

name: Core Memories
description: Each Event you attend permanently raises your maximum Focus by 2.
